thread:
Alex: FYI - POC tenant acme-poc can't SCIM provision after SAML SSO. SAML login OK, but SCIM user create returns 409 or creates user without roles. Customer blocked on onboarding.
Maria: Who's owning the POC idp config? @Devon can you take a look? Customer on Okta.
Devon: I'll take it. Can you paste the SCIM error and an example SAML assertion? Also confirm if this is Hosted API keys vs Dedicated pool onboarding.
Alex: Hosted POC (api key + dedicated test pool). Error from SCIM webhook:
```json
{
  "status": 409,
  "detail": "User with externalId already exists",
  "scim": {"schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:Error"]}
}
```
Alex: And SCIM create payload we send:
```json
{
  "userName": "j.smith@acme.com",
  "externalId": "AD:12345",
  "name": {"givenName": "John", "familyName": "Smith"},
  "groups": [{"value": "engineers"}]
}
```
Alex: SAML assertion claims customer sends:
```xml
<Attribute Name=\"urn:oid:2.5.4.42\"><AttributeValue>John</AttributeValue></Attribute>
<Attribute Name=\"email\"><AttributeValue>j.smith@acme.com</AttributeValue></Attribute>
<!-- groups coming as comma list in \"memberOf\" -->
<Attribute Name=\"memberOf\"><AttributeValue>engineers,devops</AttributeValue></Attribute>
```
Devon: Ok. Two likely issues:
- Our SCIM create uses externalId=AD:12345 but IdP is provisioning by email => duplicate/existing user mismatch.
- groups arrive as single CSV in memberOf; our SCIM expects array "groups" or group claims mapped to scim:groups.
Devon: Quick workaround: map IdP claim memberOf -> groups (array). For Okta set the Group claim to return multiple values. Also ensure NameID/email is synced to externalId or remove externalId from SCIM create.
Irina: Can we update onboarding doc / checklist? Customer shouldn't need to change tokens. Steps for Hosted POC: (1) add claim mapping for groups as multi-valued (2) ensure user identifier mapping (email vs externalId) (3) re-run SCIM bulk.
Maria: Customer asks if this needs Dedicated pool change or just IdP fix. Do we bill for rerun?
Devon: No Dedicated change. It's IdP config. Re-provisioning run is free during POC. If they want us to adjust SCIM create to tolerate externalId/email mismatch, we can patch but that's ~1 week.
OnboardBot: Automated note: scim-provisioner v2.14 deployed to prod at 2025-05-21T10:12Z (no impact).
Alex: I'll send Okta screenshots and ask if they can change memberOf to multi-valued. @Maria can you share the quick steps to customer?
Maria: On it, sending a doc link and step list now :thumbsup:
Devon: If customer can't change IdP, we can accept CSV->split server-side as temporary hotfix (scim-provisioner flag enable_memberCsvSplit=true). Will need approval.
Irina: Approved for POC only. Devon, please add flag and run through test tenant.
Devon: Will deploy feature flag to acme-poc by EOD and follow up.
